definitions.explanation: Medicine for treating symptoms of the common cold, such as fever, cough, runny nose, and sore throat. A formal term used in medical and pharmaceutical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{感冒薬|かんぼうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought cold medicine at the pharmacy.

examples.japanese: {感冒薬|かんぼうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだら→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}く→眠い：00872_nemui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I got drowsy after taking the cold medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感冒薬|かんぼうやく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で、⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦そのもの→そのもの：27432_sonomono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{治|なお}す→治す：19371_naosu⟧わけ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: Over-the-counter cold medicine only suppresses symptoms; it doesn't cure the cold itself.

notes:
Composed of {感冒|かんぼう} (common cold — formal/medical term) and {薬|やく} (medicine). This is the formal pharmaceutical term; in everyday conversation, ⟦{風邪薬|かぜぐすり}→風邪薬：09712_kazegusuri⟧ is far more common.

USAGE:
Found on medicine packaging, in medical documents, and in pharmaceutical contexts. Patients and general consumers more typically say ⟦{風邪薬|かぜぐすり}→風邪薬：09712_kazegusuri⟧ in daily conversation. The term {感冒|かんぼう} itself is a Sino-Japanese medical term for the common cold.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{総合|そうごう}→総合：16986_sougou⟧{感冒薬|かんぼうやく}: comprehensive cold medicine (multi-symptom relief)
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感冒薬|かんぼうやく}: over-the-counter cold medicine
- {感冒薬|かんぼうやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}する→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧: to take cold medicine (formal)
- {感冒薬|かんぼうやく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧: side effects of cold medicine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{風邪薬|かぜぐすり}→風邪薬：09712_kazegusuri⟧: cold medicine — the everyday term, identical in meaning but much more commonly used in conversation
- ⟦{解熱剤|げねつざい}→解熱剤：09713_genetsuzai⟧: antipyretic; fever reducer — targets fever specifically rather than cold symptoms broadly
- ⟦{鎮痛剤|ちんつうざい}→鎮痛剤：15451_chintsuuzai⟧: painkiller — addresses pain, one of several cold symptoms
